pages.text: The Sky Configurator stores a line name, line ID, and resource toggles. Right-click air to open the configurator screen; right-click a node to open its node screen. Holding the configurator in the offhand while placing a node makes the new node inherit its line and resource toggles.
The configurator is the starting point for creating lines and copying settings in bulk.

Sneak-right-click a node with the configurator to copy that node and enter paste mode. While in paste mode, right-click another node to write the stored line and resource toggles to it. Sneak-right-click again, open the configurator screen, or stop holding the configurator to leave paste mode.

Speed upgrades stack in one node upgrade slot. Each card adds one slot check per tick. By default, up to 8 cards raise the base rate from 1 to 9 slots/t; the server can configure this limit. They do not increase line capacity.

Dimension upgrades also go into node upgrade slots, but only affect extract faces. An extract face with a dimension upgrade can send to same-line insert faces in other loaded dimensions. Insert faces do not need dimension upgrades. This is not a chunk loader; unloaded dimensions or chunks are skipped.

Force Extraction Upgrades belong on extracting nodes. For devices whose mod ID appears in the server-configured list and that expose modifiable item slots, they bypass the external 64-item return cap and commit the full amount the destination can actually accept in one extraction. The default list is mekanism_extras; an empty list disables the behavior, and rejected transfers restore the source slot.

Ordered Matching Upgrades work on item extract or insert nodes. Right-click air to switch Per Slot/Per Item; Per Slot is default. Switching to Per Item clears the order offset, so switching back starts at 0. Per Slot follows local slot + order offset = network position. Sneak-scroll up/down raises/lowers the signed offset without changing the hotbar: positive values skip leading network positions (offset 2 maps slot 0 to position 2), while negative values skip leading local slots (offset -2 maps slot 2 to position 0). Extract nodes map slots to receivers; insert nodes reverse-map sources to inventory slots. Per Item cycles receivers on extract nodes and inventory slots on insert nodes, advancing after success; each batched target consumes budget. Items, fluids, FE, chemicals, mana, and source have independent order lists that ignore fullness and filter contents; the Configurator uses the same order. Failed Per Item extraction assignments use the persistent detention queue, length 1 by default.
Speed Upgrades can be crafted at a crafting table.
Ordered Matching Upgrades can be crafted at a crafting table.

Dimension upgrades are made through a tier 2 sky offering: place a Nether Star on the altar, then place 4 Eyes of Ender and 1 Chora Nectar on offering tables. The ritual takes about 12 seconds, and the upgrade only needs to be installed on the extracting node.

Force Extraction Upgrades also use a tier 2 offering: place one Speed Upgrade on the altar, then offer 4 Blaze Rods, 4 Magma Creams, 4 Crying Obsidian, and 1 Netherite Scrap. The ritual takes about 12 seconds.
